purpose: Configuration points at TLS endpoints only, so the cleartext http:// detector must stay quiet.

groundTruth.rationale: Both URLs use https://, the scheme the detector accepts; a hit would mean the pattern ignores the s of https.

limitations: Line-level lexical control: it proves the named detectors stay quiet on this shape, not that the file is free of the weakness.
Universal rules run on every analyzed file, so this control is the primary guard against false positives on ordinary code.

provenance.writtenFor: SAST evaluation-depth batch: universal negative controls (2026-10-21)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence
